item.text: {"summary":"A red macroalga native to the lower intertidal coasts of the northeastern Atlantic, including Macaronesia, and the Mediterranean. It forms loose tufts of dark reddish-purple, flattened fronds, with branches that often shorten gradually toward the tips.
